C0860.title: BlackCat Ransomware Adopts Multi-Extortion Tactics
C0860.summary: An analysis report from July 2023 indicates that the BlackCat ransomware group has added harassment or DDoS attack threats on top of its existing double-extortion strategy of encrypting files, forming a multi-extortion approach. The group also employs an 'encryption-less data leak' model, further diversifying its pressure tactics.

references.title: Beware of Data Breaches Caused by BlackCat Ransomware
